title: Mutation result is partial or unknown
starting_state: A typed mutation target has a stable identity and deterministic pre-mutation fingerprint.
The mutation call returns an ambiguous result and side effects may have applied.
expected_continuation: Checkpoint the last proven state before any semantically equivalent retry.
Perform authoritative readback against the same target.
Retry only when readback proves the first effect did not apply.
Fail closed when authoritative readback cannot distinguish applied from absent state.
forbidden_terminal_behaviors: Blindly replay the mutation before readback.
Apply a duplicate effect after readback proves the first mutation already succeeded.
Convert unknown side effects into confirmed success without authoritative evidence.
proof_ceiling: Deterministic readback/retry oracle correctness only; no real provider mutation is observed.
